block.taczturrets.fixed_turret.tooltip1: Bolted to the physics block: it only turns when the ship turns.
block.taczturrets.fixed_turret.tooltip2: Right click with a TACZ gun to install it; right click with matching TACZ ammo to load it.
block.taczturrets.fixed_turret.tooltip3: AeroIE ammo boxes refill it; empty hand opens the gun + ammo menu.
block.taczturrets.fixed_turret.tooltip4: Link it to a control seat with the AeroIE linker and fire from the seat.
block.taczturrets.seat_turret.tooltip1: Link it to an AeroIE control seat with the AeroIE linker, then aim with the mouse and fire from the seat.
block.taczturrets.seat_turret.tooltip2: Right click with a TACZ gun to install it; right click with matching TACZ ammo to load it.
block.taczturrets.seat_turret.tooltip3: AeroIE ammo boxes refill it; empty hand opens the gun + ammo menu.
block.taczturrets.seat_turret.tooltip4: Without a seated player it does nothing, so it never fires on its own.
taczturrets.menu.hint: Put the gun on top, matching ammo below
taczturrets.message.placement_hint: Right click with a TACZ gun to install it, right click with matching ammo to load it, empty hand opens the gun + ammo menu.
taczturrets.message.ammo_rejected: That ammo does not match the installed gun
taczturrets.message.no_gun_in_hand: No TACZ gun in the main hand
taczturrets.message.no_turret_targeted: The crosshair is not on a TACZ turret or a cannon mount
taczturrets.message.mount_no_gun: No gun is installed on this cannon mount yet
taczturrets.message.fixed_no_gun: The fixed turret has no gun yet: right click it while holding a TACZ gun
taczturrets.message.fixed_needs_seat: Fixed turret is armed: link it to a control seat and hold the fire input
taczturrets.message.mount_help: Cannon mount: install a gun first, then load TACZ ammo by hand or with a mechanical arm; rotation and firing come from the mount's own kinetic power and redstone.
taczturrets.screen.title: TACZ Turrets Settings
taczturrets.screen.hint: Click a button on the right, then press the key you want. Esc cancels. The mouse shortcuts still work: right click with a gun installs it, empty hand opens the gun + ammo menu.
